Meera (Marketplace PM): Quick sync: onboarding AtlasCloud to eu-central-2 marketplace. Target: list by Apr 15, announcement Apr 20. Need capacity/quotas, SKU mapping, and legal addendum status. Can partners confirm by EOD Fri?
Ana (Partnerships): @Sven can you confirm initial quota and entitlement flow? Also need SKU IDs to match billing.
Sven (AtlasCloud PM): We can provision 40 A10G-equivalent cards initially, scaleable to 120 after validation. Will need your SKU list to map.
Liam (CloudOps): FYI partner NAT egress is 8Gbps per AZ; extra egress takes ~48h to provision. Opening infra ticket now.
Meera (Marketplace PM): thx. Also need KMS setup notes and a small smoke-test command.
Liam (CloudOps): Posting checklist in thread:
- Partner entitlement created in partner console
- SKU mapping uploaded to /marketplace/schemas
- Quota ticket opened (expected sustained GPUs)
- NAT egress pre-approval (ops ticket)
- KMS keys + IAM roles for marketplace pull
- Legal addendum signed
- Smoke test plan
Sven (AtlasCloud PM): I'll have a preliminary pool for smoke tests by Wed. Working on SKU collation.
Infra-bot: Ticket #MID-8742 created: "eu-central-2 marketplace quota request (AtlasCloud)" assigned to CloudOps. https://redwood.atlassian/MID-8742
Rachel (Legal): Addendum v2 is ready; I'll attach and return redlines within 48h.
Meera (Marketplace PM): Two asks for partners: 1) SKUs by tomorrow noon, 2) confirm embargo Apr 20. Marketing will need final PR by Apr 18.
Sven (AtlasCloud PM): SKUs by tomorrow noon is tight but aiming for it. Apr 20 embargo ok.
Liam (CloudOps): sample smoke command (will push to repo):
REDWOOD_REGION=europe-central-2 PARTNER_POOL=atlas-eu-central-2 ./scripts/smoke-run.sh --model small --tokens 64
Meera (Marketplace PM): I'll open the companion PR once SKUs are in. Ping me on blockers. :thumbsup:
Ana (Partnerships): moving checklist to board. :rocket:
